newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - Nycomed 9-mo profit seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Nycomed 9-mo profit seen down.

text.p: Norwegian pharmaceutical firm Nycomed ASA, one of the world's biggest, is expected to post a nine-month pretax result of 913 million crowns, according to seven analysts polled by Reuters.
The forecast compared with a profit of 1.60 billion crowns in the same year-ago period.
Five recommended a 'hold' on the share while two recommended a 'sell,' but three who recommended a 'hold' said they may upgrade to 'buy' if the nine-month results are good enough.
Others said the launching of new products was taking too long.
Analysts were keen to find out details of the cost cuts that chief executive officer Svein Aaser has promised would be announced with the nine-month results, which will be presented on October 31.
Nycomed on August 5 said it planned to launch a group of new products and cut costs to meet tough market challenges after first-half profits fell sharply.
